scope: canonical single-phase free round jet; not evaporating spray

calibration.provenance: Direct entrainment measurement; also explicitly reported by Hussein et al. (1994), section 3.3, printed page 47. Gaussian alpha = top-hat alpha / sqrt(2).

holdout.provenance: Section 3.1, printed page 44: B_u=5.8, half-width slope=0.094. Section 3.3, printed page 47: equivalent top-hat alpha=0.081. Reported rounded fit summaries, not raw measurements or digitized points.

normalized_velocity_profile.provenance: Hussein et al. (1994), Table 4, printed page 52, first LDA row and equation 2.6. A published fit to observations, not raw point samples.

assessment.threshold_type: engineering screening tolerance, not an experimental confidence interval
assessment.independence: Only Ricou-Spalding alpha is used as a closure input. No Hussein coefficient, virtual origin, or Montazeri temperature is fitted. This is a retrospective literature holdout, not a blind preregistered test. The three reported observables are correlated.

acceptance_revision.authorization: User explicitly requested: Adjust the acceptance to 20%.
acceptance_revision.scope: Physical engineering acceptance only; measurements, predictions, source qualification and numerical/conservation gates unchanged.

dispersion_candidate.status: homogeneous numerical verification only; independent implementation validation pending
dispersion_candidate.limitations: Author manuscript section 4.3 requires additional drift terms in inhomogeneous flows. Section 5 reports failure to recover small-inertia preferential concentration. No AMD-to-k_sgs conversion is validated.
